items.title: Amazon API Gateway
items.description: API Gateway for DVA-C02. REST API vs HTTP API vs WebSocket API, integration types, authorizers (Cognito, Lambda), deployment stages, caching, throttling, CORS, canary deployments, and usage plans.

items.title: API Design — REST, gRPC & GraphQL
items.description: A complete guide to API design — REST principles, gRPC, GraphQL, pagination, rate limiting, idempotency, versioning, security, API gateway patterns, and production observability. Beginner through senior depth.

items.title: Network & Application Protocols Reference — The Complete Protocol Guide
items.description: Comprehensive reference for all essential network and application protocols — TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS, QUIC, WebSocket, SSH, FTP/SFTP, SMTP/IMAP, TLS 1.3, BGP, MQTT, and AMQP.

items.title: Real-Time Updates
items.description: Delivering real-time data to clients - short/long polling, SSE, WebSocket/STOMP, push notifications - with Spring Boot code, scaling, delivery guarantees, failure modes, observability and interview Q&A.
